subject: Draft trial plan, success criteria & exec readout scheduling — Bluebridge POC
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@bluebridgecap.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Draft trial plan & success criteria (Bluebridge)

Alyssa — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a proposed, short trial that we think will demonstrate the value you described (low-latency summarization + entity extraction for underwriting). Please confirm or adjust; once we agree I'll produce a formal POC packet for your procurement and security teams.

High-level objectives (what success looks like)
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 300ms for 1-2k token prompts under your sample load (baseline: 10 concurrent agents).
- Accuracy: Extracted entities (company name, incorporation date, revenue) >= 92% F1 on the supplied eval set.
- Cost envelope: avg token cost < $0.005 per 1k tokens (engineering goal for POC).
- Integration: API integration complete and validated with your staging dataset; no schema changes required on your side.

Proposed trial scope & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): exchange sample data + security questionnaires.
- Week 1: Redwood delivers a sandbox endpoint + 2 demo runs; Bluebridge runs smoke tests.
- Weeks 2–3: Parallel evaluation: run full sample set, collect metrics, iterate on prompts + quantization config.
- Week 4: Final readout, go/no-go decision with execs; Redwood provides contract stub for next steps if go.

Owners
- Bluebridge: Alyssa (POC lead), Thomas (eng contact), IT (security intake)
- Redwood: Rishi (sales/exec alignment), Monica (technical lead), Jordan (contracts conduit)

Immediate asks
1) Confirm the success criteria above or add/remove priorities (latency vs precision tradeoffs).
2) Share the security contact and procurement timeline; if possible attach the security questionnaire and a sample data extract.
3) Availability for a 30-min exec readout in the week of Sep 1–4 (we're proposing Sep 3 or Sep 2 afternoon PT as options).

I'll attach a draft POC plan after your confirmation.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@bluebridgecap.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Thomas Lee <thomas.lee@bluebridgecap.com>, Bluebridge IT <it@bluebridgecap.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: Draft trial plan & success criteria (Bluebridge)

Rishi — thanks for the clear recap. This aligns closely with our internal goals. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Timeline: we prefer a condensed 3-week trial rather than 4; we want a quick go/no-go to align with our Q4 roadmap. Can Redwood compress the evaluation to a 3-week window if we prioritize integration + extraction accuracy first, latency second?

2) Security/procurement: attaching our security questionnaire and a short procurement checklist (see attachment: bluebridge-security-questionnaire.xlsx). Our IT team will need the SOC2 summary and an overview of data retention/deletion procedures.

3) Exec readout: Sep 2 (2:00–2:30pm PT) works tentatively for Alyssa + Thomas, but I'll confirm with legal/procurement. If you can do Sep 3 10:00am PT as a backup, please hold both. For decision we need an ask: "recommended next contract step" (pilot extension vs enterprise contract) and a one-slide summary of risks.

4) Data: we'll share a sanitized 200-record extract by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks — looking forward.

Alyssa Chen
Head of Product, Data & Automation | Bluebridge Capital
alyssa.chen@bluebridgecap.com | +1 (646) 555-9876

Attachment: bluebridge-security-questionnaire.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@bluebridgecap.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft trial plan, success criteria & exec readout scheduling — Bluebridge POC

Alyssa — great — we can compress to a 3-week focused trial. Updated, attached POC plan (redwood-poc-plan-v2.pdf) with the compressed schedule and a clear decision checklist for the exec readout:

Compressed schedule (3 weeks) - Day 0–2: security intake + sandbox provisioning - Day 3–7: integration + smoke tests (monitored by Redwood) - Day 8–18: evaluation runs + metric collection + prompt tuning - Day 19–21: final run, readout prep, deliverables

Decision checklist for exec readout (one-slide ask)
- Technical: met accuracy threshold on sample set (>=92% F1)
- Performance: P95 latency within agreed envelope for our baseline load (or mitigation plan documented)
- Compliance: security intake satisfied (SOC2 summary + data retention policy)
- Commercial: recommended contract path (pilot-to-enterprise or enterprise commit) and proposed commercial terms range

Attachments included: redwood-poc-plan-v2.pdf, SOC2-summary-2025.pdf

Proposed exec readout slots (we'll book a 30-min slot; please confirm final attendee list):
- Thu, Sep 2, 2026 — 14:00 PT (Alyssa/Thomas tentative)
- Fri, Sep 3, 2026 — 10:00 PT (backup)

Next contract step: Jordan will send an initial term sheet and a DocuSign stub (we can keep signature flow manual until procurement signs off). Jordan — can you prepare a 1-page commercial summary we can include in the readout packet?

Monica will lead the technical runbook and be your day-to-day contact for the evaluation. Monica, can you confirm scope for prompt tuning and whether you need additional sample variants?

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@bluebridgecap.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Exec readout + contract path notes (Bluebridge POC)

Alyssa / Team — thanks for the rapid turnaround. Confirming the final schedule and a few operational notes before we send calendar invites:

1) Exec readout confirmed: Thu, Sep 2, 2026 — 14:00–14:30 PT. Please confirm final attendee names and any additional stakeholders (legal or procurement) to include.

2) Trial deliverables we'll share at readout:
- One-slide decision summary (Rishi/Jordan)
- Detailed metric pack (Monica) with F1/precision/recall, latency percentiles, and cost estimates
- Security intake confirmation (Redwood SOC2 summary + bluebridge-security-questionnaire responses)

3) Contract path & next steps:
- If go: Jordan to circulate a one-page commercial summary and a DocuSign term sheet (DocuSign link will be sent to Alyssa + legal). Expect a 3–5 business day turnaround for signature after readout unless procurement needs additional review.
- If no-go: we'll provide an itemized list of gaps and recommendations for a follow-up pilot (30 days).

4) Operational ask: please confirm the staging dataset delivery ETA (you mentioned EOD Wed — we need that by Aug 26 to hit the timeline). If there's any delay, we may need to push readout one business day.

Calendar invitation and DocuSign stub will follow from Jordan. Looking forward to the run.

Thanks — Monica

--
Monica Patel
Solutions Architect, Trials | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (678) 555-3344

Attachment references: redwood-poc-plan-v2.pdf; SOC2-summary-2025.pdf; bluebridge-security-questionnaire.xlsx
